status: PASS for exact current snapshot; final production freeze not confirmed
scope: Independent binary decode of four unique closed native GLBs, placed as six instances using plan.json. Historical R070 outer containment, two new clear bands, four new approach pads, source/ship orientation and preflight-bound comparison only.

coordinate_method.node_processing: Decode active scene hierarchy, each matrix or quaternion TRS, then actual POSITION and index accessors. Transform active referenced triangles in native GLB space, then native-to-source basis, then per-instance source Z rotation/translation, then proper source-to-ship basis. No source regeneration or render.
coordinate_method.normal_transport: All node and basis determinants are positive. Direction/normal transport uses the corresponding proper basis; winding is never reversed or sourceX silently mirrored. This is orientation verification, not a new shading-normal craft audit.
coordinate_method.wall_front: Local front -sourceY becomes +sourceX after +90 degrees, then -shipZ. Local left -X becomes -placedSourceY, toward the symbolic entrance datum.
coordinate_method.bench_faces: Public local -sourceY becomes +shipX; staff local +sourceY becomes -shipX.
coordinate_method.door_side: Placed source -Y faces +shipX, matching R070 historical +X entry edge.

region_test_method.method: Actual transformed triangle AABBs against each box contracted by 1 micrometre, with 13-axis triangle-box SAT for candidate overlaps. This rejects finite interior intrusion and separately reports boundary contact. The microscopic inset is numerical tolerance, not permitted construction clearance.
region_test_method.region_scope: Full sourceZ -0.001..10 vertical volumes as declared by the plan; all four proposed pads and both clear bands checked for all six instances.
region_test_method.solid_scope: Surface triangle screen and actual decoded bounds. Not a physics collision/occupancy/closed-volume proof; here all region pairs are separated in decoded AABB projection or only touch within numeric tolerance.

material_findings: Wall, island and workbench nominal extents are met within numerical precision except the actual workbench is 0.020 m shallower at its rear than the nominal box.

Wall-browse, island-browse and public parcel-pad boundaries have essentially zero geometric gap at the nominal fixture faces. These are boundary contacts, not positive safety clearance or actor-space guarantees.
Workbench rear has approximately 0.020 m arithmetic separation from the proposed staff-pad front. This is not an ergonomic or moving-component reserve.
All three closed containers remain in the outer allocation and clear of the six proposed empty regions. Support/contact validity and unsupported/handling states are left to the component reviewer.
This snapshot can support the bounded arrangement review. Any changed GLB, plan, state, fixture movement or protrusion invalidates the affected hashes/checks until reviewed again.
